d: At Wizwiz AI, we believe the future of artificial intelligence is built on more than powerful algorithms. It depends on the quality, context, and expertise of the people behind the data.

We connect human intelligence with AI technology to help businesses build smarter, more reliable AI systems. From data annotation and evaluation to localization and AI model improvement, we provide the human expertise needed to transform raw data into meaningful intelligence.
Location: Fully remote in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) or Oman
Estimated Earnings: USD 5.50–6.00 per hour (Payment is per recording made)

We are looking for Arabic speakers based in the UAE or Oman to participate in an audio data collection project. Participants should speak Arabic naturally, with pronunciation and an accent appropriate to the project's language requirements.
q: Native Arabic speaker or bilingual in Arabic.
Currently residing in the UAE or Oman.
Able to follow recording instructions and complete the assigned tasks independently.
Have a quiet environment and a suitable device for recording.
r: Task Volume: Record 400 sentences per participant.
Recording Content: Read and record the sentences displayed on the screen, following the provided instructions.
All recordings must be completed by the same individual. Substitutions are not allowed.
Only the account owner may use the account, and all recordings must contain the same person's voice.
Speak clearly at a moderate pace and volume to ensure every word is audible.
Record in a quiet environment without background noise, such as birds chirping, car horns, television sounds, running water, or other people's conversations.

d: Help secure the Azure environments that support Q Mobility’s services in Abu Dhabi. You’ll work hands-on with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Microsoft Purview to protect cloud infrastructure and data.
q: At least five years in cybersecurity, cloud security or security engineering, including at least two years of hands-on Azure security.
Hands-on experience with Azure identity and network security, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Key Vault and encryption, Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Purview.
A bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information security, computer science, IT or a related field.
AZ-500 or equivalent Azure security certification, hybrid or multicloud security, or AKS and DevSecOps security.
Advanced Microsoft Purview controls, or audit experience with ISO 27001:2022 and UAE Information Assurance standards.
Based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
r: Design and operate Azure security controls using Zero Trust and defence in depth.
Manage role-based access (RBAC), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Conditional Access and multifactor authentication.
Secure Azure networks with NSGs and ASGs, Private Endpoints and Private Link, Azure Firewall or Application Gateway.
Improve Secure Score, monitor compliance and configure workload protection in Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Build Microsoft Sentinel connectors, analytics rules and automation playbooks with Security Operations.
Apply data classification, sensitivity labels and data loss prevention (DLP) in Microsoft Purview. Enforce Azure Policy and use Key Vault and encryption to protect workloads and data.
Report cloud security posture and support audits.

d: Role Description This part-time remote UX Researcher role at APEPROC involves planning and conducting user research to inform digital products and services related to procurement and purchasing. The UX Researcher will design and run qualitative and quantitative studies, including interviews, surveys, usability tests, and observational research, to understand user needs and behaviors. This role includes synthesizing research findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and recommendations that support design and product decisions. The UX Researcher will collaborate closely with designers, product owners, and subject matter experts to integrate research into agile workflows and ensure solutions are usable, accessible, and aligned with user expectations. The role also involves documenting research processes, maintaining a research repository, and presenting findings to stakeholders in an understandable and actionable format.
q: Demonstrated experience in UX Research and User Research, including planning, executing, and reporting on user studies.
Strong foundation in Human Computer Interaction and Design Thinking to guide user-centered design decisions.
Advanced Analytical Skills, including the ability to interpret qualitative and quantitative data and derive actionable insights.
Familiarity with usability testing tools, survey platforms, and remote research methods.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise manner.
Ability to work independently in a remote, part-time environment and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Experience or interest in procurement, purchasing, or related business domains is an advantage.
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Design, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
